body.name: \(\mathfrak Q_{\mathrm{src}}(P^{\circ})\)
body.construction:
Let \(\mathfrak Q_{\mathrm{src}}(P^{\circ})\) denote the full-data completion class for the witness law under Assumptions 1--4 of de Chaisemartin, D'Haultf\oe{}uille, and Vazquez-Bare (2024): \(Q\in\mathfrak Q_{\mathrm{src}}(P^{\circ})\) if the observed vector has law \(P^{\circ}\), \(d\mapsto Y_t^Q(d)\) is a one-argument static potential-outcome schedule on \(I=[-2,2]\), consistency holds, the potential outcomes and the causal movement defining \(\theta(Q)\) are integrable, and for each \(d\in[-1,1]\)
\[
E_Q[Y_2^Q(d)-Y_1^Q(d)\mid X,Z]
=E_Q[Y_2^Q(d)-Y_1^Q(d)\mid X]
\qquad Q\text{-almost surely}.
\]
The observed no-stayer and marginal quasi-stayer clauses are imposed through \(P^{\circ}\). Any source regularity requiring existence of a dose derivative is read literally; the affine schedules used below have an everywhere finite derivative for each completion. This class imposes no common finite bound \(K\) on causal movements and no common finite bounds \(L,M\) on baseline trends.
